measurements.plant_part: young stems that sprout from the underground rhizome, more or less 20 cm long

measurements.equipment: HPLC (Hewlett-Packard 1100, Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA, USA). Double online detection was carried out in the diode array detector (DAD) using 280 and 370 nm as preferred wavelengths and in a mass spectrometer (API 3200 Qtrap, Applied Biosystems, Darmstadt, Germany) connected to the HPLC system via the DAD cell outlet.
measurements.citation: Pereira et al., 2014. Food and Function, 5, 1848–1855.
